final: WITH totals AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(ghome) AS total_home_games FROM team GROUP BY team_id) SELECT team_id, total_home_games, 1.0 * total_home_games / (SELECT SUM(total_home_games) FROM totals) AS share_of_all_home_games, 1.0 * total_home_games / (SELECT AVG(total_home_games) FROM totals) AS ratio_to_average FROM totals ORDER BY ratio_to_average IS NULL, ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10
